Description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Restaurant Technology Manager – UAE is the single point of accountability for all restaurant technology across the UAE market, reporting directly to the Global Head of Technology Operations. The role leads the delivery, support and continuous improvement of all in-store and guest-facing technology across brands, including POS/MIS, BSP, Digital, ALMP, Kiosk, Digital Menu Boards, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, as well as store networks, Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals. The role also manages the restaurant technology vendor portfolio end to end, including contracts, SLAs, service reviews, billing and invoice validation, and payment tracking with Finance and Procurement. By maximizing restaurant uptime, enabling fast incident resolution and ensuring accurate, cost-effective technology spend, the role protects restaurant sales and guest experience while supporting growth and digital ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Restaurant Technology Ownership:**
  Own the end-to-end management of all restaurant technology components in the UAE – POS / MIS, BSP, Digital ordering, ALMP, Kiosk, DMB, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, store network / Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals – ensuring stable, secure and standardised operation across all brands.
* **Service Operations & Incident Management:**
  Lead the UAE restaurant technology support team; define, implement and continually improve incident, problem, request and change management processes in line with ITIL and ATO standards.
* **Escalation & Major Incident Management:**
  Act as the escalation point for UAE restaurant operations both in and out of hours; lead major incidents, stakeholder communication and root cause analysis (RCA).
* **Vendor Management:**
  Manage all UAE restaurant technology vendors and service providers (POS / hardware, kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, network / telecom, payment, aggregator integration, field service): onboarding, SOWs, SLA governance, monthly service reviews, vendor scorecards, penalties / service credits and renewals, in coordination with Procurement and Legal.
* **Vendor Billing & Invoice Validation:**
  Validate every vendor invoice before approval against contract rates, POs, SOWs, asset / license / site counts, delivered services, GRNs and SLA performance; identify and recover over-billing, duplicate charges and unapplied credits.
* **Vendor Payment Validation & Tracking:**
  Validate and track vendor payments with Finance / Accounts Payable; maintain the vendor payment and accruals tracker, ensure payments are released on time and only for accepted deliverables, and resolve vendor payment disputes.
* **Budget & Cost Management:**
  Prepare and manage the UAE restaurant technology opex and capex budget; track actuals vs budget and forecast; drive cost optimisation across licenses, maintenance contracts, telecom and hardware.
* **New Store Openings, Remodels & Rollouts:**
  Deliver restaurant technology for new store openings, remodels, relocations and closures, and lead UAE rollouts of new technology (kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital) on time, on budget and to standard.
* **Asset & License Management:**
  Maintain an accurate register of restaurant hardware, software licenses and spares; plan lifecycle refresh and manage the spares pool.
* **Information Security & Compliance:**
  Ensure restaurant technology complies with Americana IT security policies, PCI-DSS for card payments and UAE regulatory requirements, including patching, endpoint protection and access control.
* **Stakeholder Management & Reporting:**
  Partner with UAE Operations, Brands, Marketing, Digital, Finance and Procurement; provide monthly service, vendor and spend performance reporting to the Global Head of Technology Operations; keep SOPs, KEDB, network diagrams and the vendor contract register up to date.
* **People Leadership:**
  Lead, coach and develop the team; set objectives, run mid-year and annual reviews, build individual development and succession plans, and manage shift and on-call rosters.
* **Other Duties:**
  Undertake other duties as assigned by the Global Head of Technology Operations.

**Qualification: -**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Master’s degree / MBA is preferred.
* ITIL v4 Foundation (or higher) certification required; PMP / PRINCE2 preferred.

**Experience: -**

* 10+ years of IT experience, including at least 5 years in a managerial role in restaurant, QSR, hospitality or retail technology.
* Excellent knowledge of restaurant technology systems and infrastructure – POS (NCR / Oracle an advantage), kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital ordering, loyalty and aggregator integrations.
* Must have delivered and supported solutions for an estate of 150+ stores; UAE / GCC experience strongly preferred.
* Proven vendor management experience, including contract and SLA management, vendor billing / invoice validation and payment reconciliation.
* Experience owning an IT opex / capex budget and reporting actuals vs budget.
* Has been through or led significant change within a restaurant or retail technology environment.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* ITIL service management – incident, problem, change and request management.
* Strong vendor and contract management, negotiation and commercial acumen.
* Invoice, billing and payment validation; financial controls, accruals and reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of retail networks, payment security (PCI-DSS) and endpoint management.
* ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow) and reporting / analytics (Excel, Power BI)
* Project and rollout management for multi-site deployments.

**Major Challenges:**

* 24/7 restaurant operations with late-night and delivery trading; on-call and out-of-hours escalations are part of the role.
* Large multi-brand estate across all Emirates with differing technology stacks, channels (dine-in, drive-thru, kiosk, delivery, aggregators) and brand requirements.
* Managing many vendors with different SLAs, contract and billing models; ensuring every invoice reflects contracted rates and delivered service, and resolving billing and payment disputes without disrupting restaurant service.
* Balancing cost control and budget discipline with restaurant uptime and guest experience; dependencies on third-party platforms (aggregators, payment providers, telecom) outside direct control.
* Fast new-store and rollout pipeline with tight, fixed opening dates.
* Frequent travel to restaurants across the UAE.

**Leadership Traits:**

* Business Succession Planning
* Business Acumen
* Entrepreneurship
* Budgets and Financial Reports
* Crisis Management

Dubai, UAE

  
  

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Lead Tunnel Geotechnical Engineer** to join our team! In this role you will take technical ownership of the **geotechnical and tunnelling engineering** of the Airport Express Line and other high-profile rail, bridge and marine programmes — leading the design of **large-diameter TBM tunnels, mined crossover caverns and deep station excavations**, setting the ground investigation strategy that underpins them, and playing your part in the development of the City's infrastructure for the 21st Century.

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

  
  

***Tunnel and Geotechnical Design Leadership:***

* Leading the geotechnical design of large-diameter (D > 10 m) TBM tunnels, including the TBM crossover caverns at rail junctions — ground treatment and pre-support, temporary and permanent support design, and excavation sequencing (SEM/NATM) of cavern and enlargement works.
* Leading deep excavation (> 30 m) methodology studies for stations, shafts and cross-passages — comparison and selection of retention systems (diaphragm wall, secant pile, top-down), base stability, dewatering and groundwater control, and the resulting construction methodology.
* Directing building and utility damage assessment for third-party structures adjacent to the alignment — volume loss and settlement prediction, Stage 1 to Stage 3 damage risk assessment, protective and mitigation measures, and instrumentation & monitoring with trigger levels and response plans.
* Predicting advance and production rates for large-diameter TBM drives, and forecasting cutter intervention frequency and location — including hyperbaric versus atmospheric intervention strategy, ground treatment at intervention points, and the effect of abrasivity, mixed-face and boulder conditions on the programme.
Owning the numerical modelling strategy (2D/3D finite element and finite difference — PLAXIS, FLAC/FLAC3D, MIDAS GTS or equivalent), soil-structure interaction, groundwater and seismic assessment, and technically reviewing the team's analyses.  

***Ground Investigation and Geotechnical Reporting:***

* Collecting, reviewing and interpreting existing and historical ground investigation data from adjacent and previous projects, and producing the project Geotechnical Interpretative Report (GIR), the geotechnical design parameters and, where required, the Geotechnical Baseline Report (GBR).
* Defining the ground investigation requirements for new projects — scope, technical specification, borehole layout and depths, in-situ and advanced laboratory testing schedules and geophysical surveys — and preparing the associated tender documents and technical evaluation.

Identify and cultivate customer advocates who are willing to share their success stories and experiences with Backbase solutions.
  
  
Collaborate with marketing teams to create case studies, testimonials, and other materials that showcase customer success.

Role Summary

We are a Dubai-based group of technology and media ventures and a direct partner of BytePlus (the enterprise arm of ByteDance). Through this partnership we distribute BytePlus AI model APIs — including the Seedance video models and other generative AI services — to businesses in the UAE and the region.

We are looking for a technical person who can run this distribution business day to day: manage the BytePlus partner and API panels, onboard and support our customers, and understand the business well enough to grow it. This is a hybrid role — half engineer, half account manager. You must be able to write code, read API docs and debug an integration, and you must also be able to sit with a customer, understand what they need and keep them happy and paying.

Key Responsibilities1. BytePlus panels and API operations

* Work daily with the BytePlus partner / distribution console and model API platform (e.g. ModelArk).
* Create and manage customer accounts, sub-accounts, API keys, quotas, rate limits and access to models.
* Monitor usage, consumption and spend per customer; catch abnormal usage or misuse early.
* Handle top-ups, credits, pricing tiers and usage reports in line with our agreement with BytePlus.
* Be our main technical contact with the BytePlus partner team: raise tickets, escalate issues, follow new model releases and changes to pricing or terms.

2. Customer onboarding and technical support

* Onboard new customers: account setup, API keys, first successful call, and getting them to production.
* Help customers integrate the APIs into their products: explain endpoints, authentication, parameters, async jobs and webhooks, error codes and limits.

3. Account management

* Own a portfolio of customer accounts: regular check-ins, usage reviews and renewals.
* Understand each customer's use case and recommend the right models, settings and plans.
* Spot upsell opportunities (more volume, new models, higher tiers) and early signs of churn.
* Keep a clean CRM record of every account: contacts, contracts, usage, issues and next steps.

4. Business understanding and reporting

* Understand how our distribution business makes money: wholesale cost, resale price, margin, volume commitments and payment terms.
* Prepare a monthly report: usage per customer, revenue, margin, top issues and growth opportunities.
* Give input on pricing, packaging and which customer segments to target.
* Follow the AI model API market (competitors, pricing, new models) and share what matters.

5. Internal tooling and automation

* Build small internal tools and scripts: usage dashboards, billing reconciliation, alerts, customer reports.
* Automate repetitive panel and reporting work using the available APIs.
* Keep internal documentation and runbooks up to date.

RequirementsMust have

* 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: solutions engineer, technical account manager, developer relations, API support or similar — or a developer who has moved into a customer-facing role.
* Solid programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs: authentication, JSON, async jobs, webhooks, rate limits, error handling.
* Experience working with a cloud or API provider console (e.g. BytePlus, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Alibaba Cloud, OpenAI or similar).
* Practical understanding of generative AI: LLMs, image and video generation models, prompts, tokens and usage-based pricing.
* Good business sense: you understand margins, usage-based billing and customer value.
* Excellent spoken and written English; able to explain technical things in plain words.
* Organised and reliable with follow-up.

Nice to have

* Direct experience with BytePlus, Volcano Engine or other ByteDance cloud products.
* Experience at a cloud reseller, distributor or managed-service partner.
* Arabic, Russian, Turkish, Chinese (Mandarin)
* Basic SQL and experience building dashboards.
* Knowledge of the UAE / GCC tech market.

Personal Qualities

* Comfortable switching between code and customer conversations in the same day.
* Proactive and owner-minded: you treat the accounts as your own business.
* Honest about problems; you escalate early instead of hiding issues.
* Fast learner who keeps up with a market that changes every month.
* Calm and patient with customers who are less technical.

Success Measures (first 6–12 months)

* All customer accounts set up, documented and monitored on the BytePlus panels.
* New customers reach their first production API call quickly and with little help from the founder.
* Clear monthly reporting on usage, revenue and margin.
* Growth in active customers and monthly API usage.
* Low churn and fast response to customer issues.

### **Job Summary**

The Project Manager – Sustainable Farming will lead the planning, implementation, and monitoring of Emirates Nature–WWF’s Sustainable Farming and Agroecology Initiative, which advances sustainable agricultural practices in the UAE to enhance food security, restore biodiversity, and strengthen the resilience of smallholder farmers.

Building on successful pilots in mountain and rural communities, the initiative aims to demonstrate climate-resilient and economically viable farming models that align with the UAE’s national priorities on sustainable food systems, biodiversity, and rural development.

The Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing the design and delivery of project activities — including demonstration farms, community capacity building, and value chain activation — while ensuring robust stakeholder engagement across government entities, private sector partners, donors, and local farmers.

This role requires strong project management expertise, a solid understanding of sustainable agriculture and ecosystem restoration, and a demonstrated ability to coordinate multi-stakeholder partnerships. The successful candidate will ensure the project’s effective delivery, governance compliance, and impact measurement, contributing directly to Emirates Nature–WWF’s strategic objectives and the UAE’s sustainability agenda.

### **Background**

Emirates Nature is a UAE environmental non-governmental charity, established in 2001 under the Honorary Founder and President H.H. Sheikh Hamdan bin Zayed Al Nahyan as a legacy of the late Sheikh Zayed’s vision for the United Arab Emirates. HH Sheikh Hamdan bin Zayed Al Nahyan is the Ruler’s representative in the Al Dhafra Region and Chairman of Environmental Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD) Board of Directors.

We operate with offices in Abu Dhabi, Dubai and Fujairah and are governed by a local board of directors.
  
Emirates Nature works in association with WWF, one of the world’s largest and most respected independent conservation organizations. Emirates Nature-WWF has been active in the UAE for two decades and is renowned for its commitment to biodiversity conservation, habitat protection, sustainable development, and community engagement. Some of our flagship projects include marine conservation initiatives to protect coral reefs and marine species, wildlife conservation programs focusing on endangered species such as Arabian oryx and sea turtles, habitat restoration projects in critical ecosystems, and sustainable development initiatives aimed at mitigating climate change impacts and promoting eco-friendly practices across various sectors.

It is our organizational objective to ensure a high performing workforce within our offices with highly efficient, skilled members all of whom will be unilaterally focused on supporting and delivering conservation activities to our stakeholders within the UAE.

The role starts as a build role — business case, project plan, statements of work, facility, approvals and team — and becomes an operating role with full P&L, budget and headcount accountability. **Responsibilities**
**Business Case & Stand-up**

* Business case — build and present the MRO business case (installed base, service offering, pricing, capex/opex, headcount, break-even, risks); own its delivery.
* Project plan & SOW — build the stand-up project plan and write the statements of work (facility fit-out, equipment and tooling, MRO/ERP software, subcontracts); run the project to plan.
* Facility & approvals — define and deliver the MRO facility, tooling and processes; obtain the applicable approvals (authorised service centre, AS9100/AS9110, CAR-145/Part-145 or military airworthiness as required).

**Business Unit P&L**

* P&L — own revenue, cost, margin and working capital; produce budget, forecasts and monthly reporting.
* Service offering — define and price repairs, overhauls, exchange pools, spares, long-term support agreements and field service; negotiate with customers alongside Commercial.
* Growth — develop the aftermarket with EDGE platform companies and regional/international operators; build business cases for MRO of other engine types.

**MRO Operations**

* Processes — establish work-scoping, inspection standards, repair schemes, build standards and release to service; maintain manuals with Engineering.
* Delivery — plan capacity and shifts; manage turnaround time, on-time delivery and first-time yield.
* Spares & field service — define spares provisioning and traceability; stand up field service and rapid-response support.

**Test Facility**

* Asset owner — own the engine test facility (test cells, dynamometers, DAQ, fuel and safety systems): availability, maintenance, calibration, upgrades and capex.
* Shared service — run acceptance and post-overhaul testing for MRO and development, endurance and qualification testing for the product programmes; agree priorities with Product Managers and Test & Development.
* Safety & operations — own SOPs, test-cell safety, operator authorisation, configuration control and test data integrity.

**Team**

* Hire & build — define the organisation and hire the team; transfer build, overhaul and test know-how from the Powertech Italy facility.
* Lead — set objectives, manage performance and develop people; safety-first, quality-first culture.

**Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Quality system — implement the MRO quality system (AS9100/AS9110) with Quality; own release documentation, records and traceability.
* HSE & compliance — own health, safety and environmental compliance for the workshop and test facility, and export-control compliance for parts and technical data.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Degree in Aerospace, Mechanical or Automotive Engineering, or equivalent technical qualification with substantial hands-on experience.
* 10+ years in engine/powertrain MRO, after-sales or test, including 5+ years leading a maintenance, overhaul or test operation with budget or P&L accountability.
* Experience standing up a new operation, facility or business line from business case to steady-state operation.
* Hands-on knowledge of piston engine build, overhaul and test.
* Experience under aviation maintenance approvals or equivalent quality systems (Part-145/CAR-145, AS9100/AS9110, military airworthiness).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* UAV/RPAS engine experience; 2-stroke, heavy-fuel and/or EFI engines; microjets.
* Defence/military customer environment; GCC market; test-cell design or commissioning.
* MRO/ERP system implementation; Lean/Six Sigma; PMP/PRINCE2; Italian or Arabic.

**Technical Skills & Tools**

* MRO processes (work-scoping, repair schemes, release to service) and reliability programmes (TBO, MTBUR, warranty).
* Engine test-cell infrastructure and operations (dynamometers, DAQ, fuel and safety systems); test data interpretation.
* Business-case and P&L modelling, budgeting, project management, SOW writing, supplier management; MRO/ERP systems.

THE DUTIES OF ALL GPs ARE AS FOLLOWS:
  
a. The GP does not have admission privileges and will transfer care to a Specialist or Consultant when admission or medical centre transfer is required.
  
b. They will take Most Responsible Physician (MRP) responsibilities for patients under their direct care in the Primary care clinic.
  
c. The position of MRP can only be transferred with the agreement of another physician.
  
d. They will give professional advice and provide technical services, for which they are privileged, to another GP or their patient as requested.
  
e. They will both give and request consultations according to the medical centre policies on consultations.
  
f. They will take professional responsibility for the care given to their patients by themselves in the environment provided by the medical centre management.
  
g. They are expected to work in a collegiate manner with all medical centre staff.
  
h. They are expected to work within the various rules, regulations and guidelines of the Section and Department in which they work.
  
i. They are expected to contribute to the production of Clinical Guidelines, Critical Care Pathways and Managed care processes as needed for the care of their patients or upon the request from their line managers.
  
j. Take ‘on-call’ duty, according to the department rota and the needs of their patients.
  
k. When going off duty, they will therefore ensure that the process of handover is carried out appropriate to the patient’s requirements.
  
l. The GP is responsible for ensuring in their area of work that the patient and or the family are kept fully informed about their condition in an ethical and humane manner.
  
m. He/she is also responsible for protecting the patient from anxiety related to partially known or poorly understood medical conversation. Criticism of colleagues in front of patients or relatives is never good medical practice unless it is in a strict medical legal consultation situation and where they are prepared to put the criticism in writing.
  
n. GPs must discuss with their Head of Department all examples of serious or repeated minor failures to perform by other medical staff. This will ensure necessary intervention at an early stage.
  
o. They will ensure that all the medical records of their patients are completed in an accurate, legible, and timely manner according to the policy on the subject.
  
p. They will take part in mortality and morbidity meetings in an open and collegiate manner to ensure fairness and truth in the discussions.
  
q. They will maintain confidentiality in all matters according to the policy of the DOH.
  
r. They will contribute to the teaching of nurses, other personnel, patients and their careers and the public as needed.
  
s. They will attempt to improve their service to the patients through audit, research, attendance at educational events and the use of the library and other educational facilities.
  
t. Participate in continuous quality improvement of the medical centre as and when required and any other work assigned by the HOD within the scope of the job.
  
u. Has sole responsible for issuing DOH Sick Leave from the DOH website.

### \*A. Air Conditioning (AC) & HVAC Maintenance\*

1. Perform regular inspection and preventive maintenance of all split AC, package AC, central AC and HVAC systems.

2. Clean and replace AC filters as per the maintenance schedule.

3. Clean evaporator and condenser coils.

4. Inspect and clean AC drainage lines and drain trays to prevent water leakage.

5. Check refrigerant gas pressure and identify refrigerant leakage.

6. Inspect compressors, thermostats, fan motors and control systems.

7. Check AC cooling performance and maintain the required temperature.

8. Troubleshoot AC breakdowns, cooling problems and abnormal noise.

9. Inspect ducting, insulation, air diffusers and ventilation systems.

10. Monitor AC electricity consumption and report abnormal readings.

11. Coordinate with specialist AC contractors for major repairs and gas charging when required.

12. Maintain AC maintenance records for all branches.

### \*B. Electrical Maintenance\*

1. Inspect and maintain electrical distribution boards (DBs).

2. Repair electrical wiring, switches, sockets and lighting.

3. Troubleshoot electrical faults and power failures.

4. Inspect circuit breakers, isolators and electrical protection systems.

5. Support PAT testing and electrical safety inspections.

6. Monitor electrical load distribution.

7. Report electrical hazards and abnormalities.

### \*C. Mechanical & Kitchen Equipment Maintenance\*

1. Maintain commercial kitchen equipment.

2. Inspect refrigerators, freezers, chillers and cooling equipment.

3. Maintain pumps, motors and exhaust fans.

4. Inspect ventilation and fresh-air systems.

5. Troubleshoot mechanical breakdowns.

6. Coordinate specialist equipment repairs when required.

### \*D. Plumbing Maintenance\*

1. Repair water leakage and damaged pipes.

2. Maintain water pumps, valves and water supply systems.

3. Repair taps, sinks and washbasins.

4. Inspect drainage systems and clear blockages.

1. Follow company HSE policies and UAE safety requirements.

2. Use appropriate PPE.

The Project Manager holds single-point accountability for the delivery of large-scale building projects valued at AED 150 million or more, from contract award through to handover, defects liability and final account. 3. Client & Stakeholder Management

* Build, lead and develop the project team including the Construction Manager, site engineers, planners, quantity surveyors, QA/QC and HSE staff.

* Set objectives, monitor performance and mentor staff to strengthen technical, commercial and managerial capability.

* Maintain high standards of professional conduct and integrity.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX**
-------------------------------------------

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

---------------

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.

* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.

Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.

* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.

* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve audit efficiency, risk assessment, testing methodologies, and reporting processes.
* Assess governance and controls over AI and machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, monitoring, explainability, accountability, bias management, and data governance.
* Develop and execute data-enabled audit approaches using analytics, visualization, automation, and continuous auditing techniques.
* Assess risks associated with generative AI technologies, large language models, agentic systems, and third-party AI services.
* Lead and execute technology audit engagements from planning through reporting.
* Perform audits of cloud environments, including governance, security, identity and access management, resilience, and third-party risk controls.
* Assess DevSecOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, secure software development practices, and deployment controls.
* Evaluate governance, risk management, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations associated with AI solutions and emerging technologies.
* Assess IT general controls, automated controls, application controls, and cybersecurity controls.
* Participate in audits of major technology transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, and digital programs.
* Support integrated audits by identifying technology risks that may impact business processes.
* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging risks and industry trends related to cloud computing, AI, cyber security, and software engineering.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across audit methodologies, quality assurance processes, audit technology, and reporting practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on risk, governance, and control matters.
* Provide guidance and coaching to junior auditors and co-op students where applicable.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of technology risk management and control frameworks including NIST, COBIT, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Hands-on experience auditing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience reviewing DevSecOps environments, Agile delivery practices, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle controls.

* Experience using data analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Diligent/ ACL, Python, SQL, Databricks, or equivalent tools.

The Role

You’ll take the time to understand not just what a customer is asking for, but why: their goals, priorities, and the outcomes they want to reach. You’ll own the full configuration journey. That means writing the configuration specifications, setting up the product, verifying that every configuration works as intended, and delivering it to the customer. You’ll then prepare training materials and train customers so they’re confident using their configured solution from day one.

You’ll be the customer’s advocate inside Afflo.io, working closely with Customer Success Managers, Product, QA, Delivery, and Support teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

Understand the customer

* Engage with customers to understand their needs, goals, and the reasons behind their requests, so the solution supports their real objectives.
* Review customer workflows, identify gaps, and capture needs as functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Configure the product

* Translate customer needs into configuration specifications covering workflows, settings, roles, rules, and other product options.
* Configure the product for each customer based on the approved specifications.
* Maintain configuration specifications as living documents, keeping them accurate and up to date as customer needs change.
* Manage changes to customer configurations and requirements with clear traceability and formal change control.

Verify and deliver

* Verify every configuration against the specification and the customer’s acceptance criteria before delivery.
* Support customers throughout their user acceptance testing (UAT), from preparing test scenarios and guiding their testers to answering questions as they test.

* Support customer integration and data migration work by analyzing their data and systems, defining data mapping and transformation rules, and documenting data exchange requirements such as API events and formats.

* Deliver configured solutions to customers and support their move from implementation to steady-state operations.

Train and enable

* Prepare customer-facing training materials, including guides, user manuals, quick-reference sheets, and demo scripts tailored to each customer’s configuration.
* Deliver training sessions and product demonstrations to customer users and administrators.
* Gather feedback after training and refine materials to improve adoption.

Support ongoing success

* Monitor customer usage, engagement, health, and service quality indicators, and escalate risks to the Customer Success Manager.
* Coordinate customer requests, issues, defects, and feedback across internal teams, track them through resolution, verify fixes, and keep customers informed until each item is closed.
* Maintain success plans, process maps, data flows, quality checklists, action items, and account documentation.
* Take part in post-implementation and post-release reviews to confirm that solutions continue to meet customer needs.
* Spot recurring customer issues, adoption challenges, and configuration or quality trends, and share ideas for continuous improvement.

**Who are we looking for?**
We are seeking an experienced Nuclear Project Director to support the growth and delivery of complex nuclear and energy capital projects across Canada and North America. This role will provide senior leadership across strategic project portfolios, major project execution, client engagement, governance, risk management, and multidisciplinary delivery. The successful candidate will bring a proven ability to lead large capital programs from proposal, early planning through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational readiness.
  
  
This is a senior, delivery and client-facing leadership role for a professional who can quickly assess business priorities, establish project discipline, build strong delivery teams, and support clients through complex decisions involving capital allocation, operational risk, reliability, safety, stakeholder expectations, and long-term asset performance.
  
  
**Working with an energetic and high-performing team, this position will see you involved in:**

* Serve as Project Director on complex nuclear, energy, and major infrastructure and advisory projects, providing senior oversight from concept and feasibility through execution, commissioning, and closeout.
* Lead strategic project portfolios, including capital planning, project selection, governance, prioritization, and execution readiness for clients with large-scale CAPEX programs.
* Support GHD’s Energy growth objectives by helping originate, shape, and deliver opportunities across nuclear power, nuclear waste, nuclear decommissioning, renewable power generation, hydropower, transmission and distribution, and industrial energy systems.
* Partner with Market and Sector Leaders, Business Group Leaders, Relationship Managers, technical specialists, and regional delivery teams to develop capture plans, position GHD for strategic pursuits, and convert opportunities into profitable backlog.
* Provide executive-level client leadership, building trusted relationships with nuclear operators, OEMs, waste management, Indigenous communities, government agencies, contraction partners, and financing organizations.
* Lead multidisciplinary project teams, including engineering, environmental, permitting, Indigenous engagement, project controls, procurement, construction management, commissioning, and operations readiness resources.
* Establish and implement project governance, risk management, change management, commercial controls, communication protocols, and decision-making frameworks that improve delivery certainty.
* Drive safety leadership and promote a strong site safety culture across project teams, contractors, and client stakeholders.
* Guide value engineering, constructability reviews, scope control, cost optimization, schedule recovery, and issue resolution on major capital projects.
* Mentor project managers and emerging leaders, strengthening GHD’s project delivery capability and helping build a scalable major projects platform across Energy.
* Collaborate across Canada, the United States, and global GHD networks to leverage technical capability, Global Collaboration Centres, and best-practice delivery models.

**What you will bring to the team:**

* Engineering degree or related technical qualification is preferred; graduate education in project management, business administration, or a related discipline is an asset.
* Professional licensure or eligibility preferred (P.Eng. + PMP).
* 15-18 years of experience in the nuclear, energy, or related sector, including business development, project management, and technical leadership for major infrastructure.
* Extensive senior leadership experience in project direction, project portfolio management, capital project execution, operations leadership, and general management within energy, nuclear, aerospace, or related sectors.
* Demonstrated experience leading major capital projects and portfolios, including projects valued in the hundreds of millions of dollars.
* Proven ability to lead end-to-end project execution, including facility design, equipment selection, consultant and contractor selection, construction management, commissioning, and operations turnover.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience managing scope, cost, schedule, procurement, contracts, risk, change, and governance on complex projects.
* Track record of improving project outcomes through value engineering, contractor engagement, cost optimization, project controls, and disciplined issue resolution.
* Experience supporting nuclear or energy sector clients through strategic growth, operational improvement, reliability, maintenance, and asset performance initiatives.
* Strong executive presence and ability to work effectively with senior leadership teams, Boards of Directors, clients, contractors, government stakeholders, and community partners.
* Experience working with Indigenous communities and an understanding of the importance of respectful engagement, partnership, social license, and community benefit in major project development.
* Ability to build, motivate, and lead high-performing teams over multi-year project lifecycles.
* Proven experience in nuclear business development in a market-facing role is required.
* Commitment to health, safety, quality, inclusion, collaboration, and GHD’s values as an employee-owned organization.
* Experience with Design Bid Build (DBB), Design Build (DB), and alternative delivery projects such as Progressive DB, Integrated Project Delivery/Alliance and/or P3 considered an asset.

**Vancouver, BC**

The BC Centre for Disease Control (BCCDC) provides provincial and national leadership in public health through surveillance, detection, prevention and consultation and provides both direct diagnostic and treatment services to people with diseases of public health importance.

The BCCDC is seeking a permanent Public Health Physician in the Communicable Disease Prevention and Response (CDPR) Unit. Reporting to the Medical Director, the Public Health Physician will provide clinical and public health leadership across a range of communicable disease priorities. The initial portfolio is expected to include a significant focus on respiratory infections, while maintaining flexibility to contribute to other emerging and evolving priorities within CDPR.

BCCDC, in collaboration with public health partners, identifies and responds to provincial population and public health priorities, which may shift over time. This work advances Indigenous-specific anti-racism and cultural safety and embeds respect for Indigenous rights, self-determination, and distinctions-based approaches across public health practice.

The focus of the Communicable Disease Prevention and Response Unit is to identify, assess and respond to a range of infectious disease threats, including but not limited to respiratory viruses, novel and emerging pathogens, vaccine preventable diseases, tuberculosis, and sexually transmitted infections through surveillance, partner engagement, program development, and public health policy.

**Role and responsibilities**

The Public Health Physician provides medical expertise and consultation to support provincial surveillance, risk assessment, preparedness and response, outbreak management, risk communication and the development and evaluation of public health policy, guidance and programs. The physician will work closely with other CDPR physicians and multidisciplinary teams on the development of strategic activities, public health policies, programs, and practices in collaboration with operational counterparts. The Public Health Physician consults, partners, and collaborates with Regional Health Authorities, First Nations Health Authority, Métis Nation British Columbia, Office of the Provincial Health Officer, Ministry of Health and other provincial ministries to characterize and address various communicable diseases.

The role will support the CDPR Unit and BCCDC in the development, monitoring, evaluating, and disseminating provincial public health policies, guidelines, and standards of practice to support quality service delivery. In collaboration with other public health leaders, this role will identify evidence-based outcomes, develop quality indicators and care pathways, ensure compliance with accreditation standards, and coordinate or participate in quality improvement activities with a focus on patient safety and improved population health outcomes.

**Qualifications**

Applicants must be eligible for licensure as a specialist in British Columbia and hold Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada certification or equivalent qualifications in a specialty related to public health, such as public health and preventive medicine, community medicine, infectious diseases or a related area.

The successful candidate will have:

1-The Rural Lead, Northeast oversees over 1,300 staff and budget over $107M across seven rural sites, in the communities of Athabasca, Boyle, Cold Lake, Elk Point, Lac La Biche, Smoky Lake and St. Paul.

The Rural Leads are responsible and accountable for leading the effective oversight of hospital-based leadership within the assigned area of accountability.

About Us

Founded in 2004 in Quebec by five people who had lived with Multiple Chemical Sensitivity (MCS), the Environmental Health Association of Canada (EHAC-ASEC), work under shared leadership to advance research, public and clinical education, accessible indoor air standards, ecological housing, and frontline support for Canadians living with MCS.

About 3.1 million Canadian adults (9.4%) report MCS and about 900,100 (2.7%) report a medical diagnosis (Statistics Canada, preliminary 2025). About 70% of adults reporting MCS are women. Cloud environments rarely stand alone, so you must have hands-on experience attacking the identity systems connected to them. You will combine offensive technique, a working knowledge of how cloud environments are built and operated, and creative problem-solving to help clients understand and reduce their risk.

[Confidential] is building a new team to deliver complete IT fit-outs of data halls, from an empty room to live, tested and documented computing capacity. Once the building shell, power and cooling are in place, our crews take the white space from A to Z: receiving and staging, rack and cabinet placement, overhead pathways, bonding and grounding, copper and high-density fibre, network and server hardware, testing, power-up and handover to the client.

As a Senior Technician, you are the go-to technical lead on site. You turn drawings and cable schedules into the day's work, run a crew of Level 2 technicians, do the hard technical work yourself, solve the problems others can't, and sign off on quality before anything is handed over. This is a working lead role: you'll spend most of your day hands-on alongside your crew.

**The scope: a full data hall fit-out, A to Z**

Every project follows the same lifecycle, and you'll lead your crew through all of it:

1. Pre-construction: Review drawings, rack elevations, cable schedules, port maps and fibre plans; confirm site readiness; flag design conflicts before work starts

2. Receiving and staging: Receive, inspect, inventory and stage racks, cabinets, cable, optics and hardware; report damaged or missing items

3. Racks and cabinets: Lay out, place, level, bolt together and anchor racks and cabinets to the floor plan; install containment, doors, side panels, blanking panels and cable managers

4. Bonding and grounding: Install and verify rack and pathway bonding to the site grounding system per drawings and standards

5. Overhead pathways: Install ladder rack, basket tray, fibre guide/runway and supports (threaded rod, Unistrut), keeping clearances and segregation to plan

6. Structured cabling: Pull, route, dress and terminate copper (Cat6/6A) and fibre, including pre-terminated MPO/MTP trunks, LC, patch panels and cassettes; maintain bend radius and fill ratios

7. Rack-and-stack: Install servers, switches, storage, GPU/AI systems, optics and rack PDUs to rack elevations; patch to port maps and cut sheets

8. Labelling and records: Label every cable, port, panel and rack to the client's scheme (TIA-606 practice); barcode-scan and record assets

9. Testing and certification: Fibre inspection and cleaning, OLTS (Tier 1) and OTDR (Tier 2) testing, copper certification, continuity and polarity checks; fix and retest any failures

10. Power-up and validation: Support power-on and green-light checks, out-of-band management connectivity, link and loopback testing, and burn-in with the client's engineers

11. Quality and handover: Run QA/QC inspections and punch lists, complete as-built drawings, test reports and asset records, and walk the client through handover

Your customers use more of the platform, in more parts of their business, and can point to results in their own numbers. They see you as part of their team. Renewals and growth follow from that work. * Agir comme conseiller.ère de confiance et personne-ressource clé auprès de clients issus des services publics, de l’industrie et du secteur des énergies renouvelables en vous basant sur une compréhension claire de ce qui fait la réussite d’un projet, du concept à l’exploitation commerciale

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

**Walking**

For short distances for short durations

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

**Sitting**

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

**Lifting**

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

**Carrying**

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

**Pushing**

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

**Crouching/Squatting**

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

**Reaching**

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

**Head of Engineering Job Description:** Scope, Impact & Qualifications Reports to: CEO Level: Executive (CTO-equivalent scope) Org size: ~25 engineers Time split: 70% Product / 30% Discipline ROLE SUMMARY The Head of Engineering owns the technical outcomes of Maestro's entire product suite while also serving as the top of the engineering discipline ladder: every engineering manager and individual contributor ultimately ladders up to this role. The position deliberately splits attention: 70% product execution, 30% discipline accountability. Product delivery is the immediate, ongoing accountability; discipline work compounds over time and requires protected but smaller blocks of focus so it doesn't get crowded out by delivery pressure. This role sits at the center of Maestro's matrix structure, accountable for craft quality and standards company-wide, while ensuring embedded engineering talent on each product team is pointed at the right priorities.
  
  
**SCOPE • Org reach:** all engineering leads across all product lines report into this role (directly or via a lead layer), the senior-most engineering accountability in the company. • Product surface: full product suite, every active product line's engineering output. • Discipline surface: engineering-wide standards, tooling, and process, independent of which product team an engineer sits on. THE 70%: PRODUCT ACCOUNTABILITY The Head of Engineering is the single accountable owner for engineering execution across Maestro's product portfolio.
  
  
**What this looks like day to day:** • Partners with the engineering leads of every product line to ensure their teams are resourced against the right priorities: not just busy, but correctly sequenced. • Accountable for ensuring product strategy and roadmap direction are translated into clear, actionable engineering plans, serving as the connective layer between Product and Delivery leadership and the engineering organization, primarily through engineering leads embedded within product teams. • Accountable for applying technical judgment to turn high-level strategic priorities into concrete technical execution plans, enabling and guiding engineering leads to scope, sequence, and de-risk delivery across their product areas. • Identifies where product priorities and engineering capacity are misaligned across teams and resolves the tradeoff, including cross-team resourcing calls.
  
  

* Is the escalation point when a product line's engineering execution is off track, and is accountable for getting it back on track. Impact: Every product line ships against strategy, not just against what's easiest to build. Product and Delivery leaders have one accountable engineering partner instead of negotiating separately with each product line's lead. THE 30%: DISCIPLINE ACCOUNTABILITY The Head of Engineering owns what "good engineering" means at Maestro, independent of the product line.

**What this looks like day to day:** • Sets and maintains company-wide engineering standards (code quality, architecture principles, technical debt posture). • Owns cross-cutting technical initiatives that no single product team should solve independently, e.g. product suite services and universal QA automation. • Defines how AI tooling is used across engineering, including guardrails to ensure AI usage improves output quality and velocity rather than introducing risk or degrading craft.
  
  

* Identifies and removes friction in how engineering work gets done company-wide, streamlining processes that slow every team down in the same way. • Is the ultimate accountable owner for engineering management practice (how EMs lead, how performance is evaluated, how the craft is grown) even where day-to-day people management is embedded in product teams. Impact: Engineering quality, velocity, and management practice don't fragment by product line. An engineer's experience of "how we build software here" is consistent no matter which team they're on, and the org gets the benefits of scale (shared tooling, shared standards) instead of each team reinventing its own.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Engineers across the organization deliver flawless technical execution that earns long-term client retention and supports growth. • Product lines are resourced against strategic priority, with tradeoffs made explicitly rather than by default. • Engineering leads across product lines operate with a shared technical bar and shared tooling. • Company-wide initiatives (QA automation, AI usage standards) ship and get adopted, not just get designed.
  
  

* Engineering management practice is consistent and healthy across the org, even though EMs are embedded in product teams day to day. QUALIFICATIONS Maestro hires for demonstrated capability, not years-of-service checkboxes. The bar below is competency-based: what someone needs to be able to do, not how long they've been doing it. Required competencies: • Has personally carried end-to-end accountability for engineering delivery across more than one product or team simultaneously: not just led a single team, but balanced competing priorities across several.
* Can translate ambiguous, high-level strategy (from product, business, or leadership) into a technical execution plan that engineers can actually build against, without needing someone else to do that translation. • Has designed or materially improved an engineering standard, process, or tooling investment that worked across teams (not a single-team fix) and can point to the before/after. • Comfortably operates in a matrixed environment, influencing and aligning engineering leads, their teams, and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority. • Has hands-on technical depth sufficient to earn credibility with senior engineers and to personally evaluate technical tradeoffs.

This is not a purely managerial role. • Has direct experience managing or mentoring engineering managers, not only individual contributors. • Demonstrates sound judgment on when to standardize company-wide versus when to let product teams operate with autonomy. Strongly preferred: • Experience operating at this scope inside a company of comparable size (roughly 15 to 50 engineers), where formal process is lighter and judgment calls happen more often than policy lookups.
  
  

* Direct experience setting a company's approach to AI-assisted engineering (tooling choices, guardrails, or usage standards) rather than just using AI tools personally. • A track record of building or scaling QA automation, testing strategy, or release process across multiple teams. • Experience partnering directly with Product and Delivery leadership as a peer, not just receiving requirements from them. • Experience leading engineering for always-on, customer-facing digital products or live-service platforms, where availability, release discipline, observability, incident response, and rapid cross-functional coordination directly affect the end-user experience and client retention.

**What we're explicitly not requiring:** • A specific prior title (VP Engineering, CTO, etc.). We care about scope actually carried, not the title it came with. • A minimum years-of-experience threshold. Competency and evidence of impact matter more than tenure.
  
  

* Deep expertise in every technology in Maestro's stack. Technical judgment and the ability to evaluate tradeoffs matter more than hands-on fluency in any one language or framework.

**The Assistant Manager – Global Base Operations NOC** is the direct leader for all Supervisors on Demand (SoD), who are the first line of support for flight attendants and base leadership. This role is separate from the Inflight Duty Manager (IFDM) role and centralizes administration for the IFDM and SoD programs, including reporting, program documentation, hiring coordination, and stakeholder communications. The Assistant Manager remains qualified on both the IFDM and SoD desks to support the operation when staffing is short. By owning these responsibilities, the role allows IFDMs to focus on safety, reliability, and flight attendant experience, while creating a consistent Global Base Operations experience and reducing base administration workloads so local bases can focus on their operation.

* Serves as the direct leader for all Supervisors on Demand (SoD). Conducts one-on-ones, coaching, recognition, manages performance; approves SoD time off, shift trades, and overtime based on coverage needs and policy; and sets expectations, shares program updates, and leads SoD team huddles.
* Maintains qualification on both the IFDM and SoD desks and works IFDM desk or SoD shifts during vacancies, call-outs, training, or irregular operations (IRROPs), providing real-time support to flight attendants, bases, and NOC partners and keeping flight attendant call response times on target. Balances administrative deadlines with operational coverage and escalates to the Manager when both cannot be met.
* Build and maintains SoD schedules to ensure 24/7 coverage, including vacation, holiday, training, and IRROPs adjustments. Manages eTA time and attendance entries, conducts regular audits, ensures compliance with United's time and attendance policy, and maintains dependability tracking and documentation for the Manager's review.
* Compiles and distributes recurring program reports, including the SoD daily log, phone statistics, and year-to-date summaries, providing timely, accurate data to senior leaders, base teams, and NOC stakeholders. Partners with the Data and Analytics team to automate reporting using Power BI, Microsoft Forms, and Power Automate.
* Maintains the IFDM Business Continuity Plan (BCP), emergency call tree, and contact rosters, and coordinates annual reviews and exercises. Keeps the IFDM and SoD SharePoint, checklists, templates, and Flying Together pages current, and tracks training completion, recurrent training, and required certifications to ensure compliance with company policy and the JCBA.
* Coordinates recruitment with Human Resources, including postings, interview scheduling, and communications with applicants. Manages onboarding for new supervisors, including system access, training plans, and orientation, and organizes inputs, timelines, and documentation for mid-year and year-end review cycles.
* Schedules and prepares materials for monthly IFDM and L5 base collaborations, team huddles, NOC Open House events, and leadership presentations; captures meeting notes and action items and follows up with base leaders, Crew Scheduling, and NOC partners. Supports process improvement and technology initiatives, including AI-powered chat tools and automated workflows, and serve as backup to the Manager for administrative decisions and program continuity during absences.

**About This Role**
At Chime, we help our members achieve financial peace of mind. To do this we need features that are highly available and human & technical systems that are resilient. That’s where you come in. You will be a member of our Incident Response team to help Chime improve our readiness, response and drive organizational change from incidents.
  
  
As an Incident Operations Manager on Chime's Incident Operations team (Platform Engineering), you'll manage incidents end to end: from declaration and coordination, through member communication and member remediation, to review and follow-through. You'll work across Engineering, Product, Member Experience (MX), Core Experience, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, and lead through influence rather than authority. You'll bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and keep the member at the center of every decision. Alongside on-call work, you'll own defined improvement workstreams that make our response better every quarter.
  
  
**In This Role, You Can Expect To**

* Coordinate incidents end to end. Serve on the incident on-call rotation, including some after-hours coverage on weekends, nights, and holidays. Independently run incidents from declaration to resolution: setting severity, paging the right responders, running the bridge, confirming member impact, and driving mitigation decisions.
* Help drive communication during incidents. Draft clear, accurate member messages across in-app, push, inbox, email, and support channels; move them through Compliance and Legal approval within severity-based timelines; and keep Support and MX teams equipped with talking points.
* Drive member remediation to closure. Run the Remediating phase: define workstreams, DRIs, and exit criteria; partner with Data to size the impacted population; coordinate credits and bulk adjustments with Finance, Compliance, and Core Experience
* Keep stakeholders informed. Deliver timely status reports and sitreps for leadership, and supply impact summaries and timelines that Compliance and Legal use for bank partner and regulatory notifications.
* Close the loop. Facilitate incident reviews for the incidents you manage, capture learnings, and make sure corrective actions have owners and due dates.
* Get ahead of problems. Spot risks and gaps before they become incidents or repeat incidents, raise them early, and come up with a proposed solution.
* Improve how we respond. Own at least one program workstream, such as pre-approved member message templates, runbooks, or response metrics, and ship measurable improvements.
* Cross-train and share knowledge. Build working fluency on both the technical-command and member-impact sides of an incident, and help train coordinators and responders.

**To thrive in this role, you have**

* 3+ years in incident management, or a similar operational role, including hands-on coordination of live, customer-impacting incidents.
* A strong member focus. You think first about how an incident affects real people and their money, and you measure success by whether members are informed and made whole, not just whether systems are restored.
* A proactive, solution-oriented approach. You act before being asked, look for the next risk instead of waiting for it, and bring options and recommendations.
* Experience managing the customer side of an incident: writing customer-facing communications, working with support teams, and coordinating remediation.
* Calm, structured judgment under pressure; you know when to decide, when to escalate, and when to ask for help.
* Enough technical fluency to follow engineers through an investigation and ask good questions (observability, deploys, dependencies, distributed systems).
* Experience with incident and observability tools such as PagerDuty, incident.io, Datadog, Slack-based incident tooling, Jira, and Google Workspace.
* Clear, concise writing for different audiences: members, technical SMEs, compliance partners, and executives.
* Strong follow-through; you drive action items and remediation work to closure without being chased.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or another regulated industry.

The Lead Relay Technician is an advanced-level technical position responsible for leading and performing the testing, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning of protective relaying systems and associated control equipment with minimal supervision. This role serves as the designated crew leader on assigned projects and is responsible for ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with all customers, industry, and company standards. Lead Relay Technician is encouraged to recommend measures to improve field service operations, technical execution, crew productivity, and customer service. The Lead Relay Technician may be assigned work individually or as part of a larger electrical substation, transmission, distribution, generation, or industrial power project.

Lead Relay Technician reports directly to the Relay Operations Manager and works closely with engineers, project managers, customers, and field personnel. This position provides direct oversight, coordination, and mentorship to Relay Technician I, II, III and Senior personnel assigned to the project.

Effective communication with Relay Operations Manager and Relay Supervisor is required throughout active projects and when awaiting assignment and/or standby time.

Often requires extensive travel and non-standard schedules at field locations with exposure to varying environmental conditions.

What You'll Do:

**Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:**

* Lead the testing, inspection, maintenance, field repair, troubleshooting, and commissioning of protective relaying and related systems, including:
  + Transmission and distribution (T&D) line protection schemes
  + Transformer (bank) differential and restricted earth fault protection
  + Bus differential schemes
  + Breaker protection, breaker failure, and transfer trip schemes
  + Generator and motor protection systems
  + Reclosing, synchronizing, and transfer schemes
  + Electromechanical, solid state, and microprocessor-based relays and networked protection systems
  + Metering, remote controls, and data systems
* Perform and oversee:
  + End-to-end relay testing
  + Primary and secondary injection testing
  + Function testing of all devices to verify proper operation, including functional and logic verification
  + Trip and close circuit validation
  + DC system and battery testing and verification
  + Point-to-point wiring checks
  + Examination and evaluation of control circuits, control equipment, voltage regulators, and other related equipment
  + Identification, diagnosis, and resolution of electrical issues during commissioning
  + Troubleshooting and root cause analysis of relay mis-operations
* Apply a deep understanding of protection schemes (overcurrent, differential, and distance) and SCADA integration.
* Serve as the on-site lead responsible for crew safety, daily work planning, and execution of the assigned scope of work.
* Review project drawings, schematics, blueprints, relay settings files, and scope of work before and during execution. Cross-check control and protective circuit diagrams to ensure the system meets industry and utility standards.

* Mentor, train in the field, and provide technical guidance to Relay Technician I, II, III, and Senior personnel and other technicians.
* Review and ensure the accuracy of field reports, commissioning documentation, and as-built redlines.
* Complete time, expense, and field service job reports using online/administrative tools or software.
* Conduct and participate in job briefings, tailboard meetings, and hazard assessments.

* Travel to job sites as required, including overnight travel and extended assignments.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by the Relay Operations Manager or Supervisor.

* Demonstrated experience leading field crews and managing relay projects

* Advanced understanding of power system protection and coordination principle
